content:
maya: heads up — starting the staggered shift canary for 2026-03-20 change window. deploying v2.8.1 to eu-west batch 1.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] kickoff at 2026-03-20T02:30Z. preflight checks: config, secrets, healthchecks queued.

maya: preflight passed locally but dashboards show p50/p95/p99 ok. will push traffic 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 15m.

deploy-bot: observability preflight: alert if p95 latency > 300ms or error rate > 0.5% for 5m. running smoke traffic.

jordan: seeing a small 5xx uptick on embed-router ~15s after shift to 5% — grafana link in thread.

eva: grafana: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/abc123/staggered-shift — embed-router 5xx: 0.02% -> 0.6% at 02:34Z :warning: 

sam: @maya recommend pause and hold at 5%. route remaining traffic to v2.7.9. can we pin route?

maya: thanks. can we confirm it's only embed-router? any downstream cascade? @oncall-runner, can you snapshot traces + span rates?

oncall-runner: running quick traces query: `service:embed-router AND status:5xx` -> spike concentrated on node eu-west-03; KV cache miss rate +12% (short window).

jordan: looks like kvcache TTL regen coincides with canary. maybe cache warming regression with new kvprefetch logic in v2.8.1.

sam: propose: 1) pause rollout 2) pin traffic back 3) rollback v2.8.1 on eu-west-03 4) create hotfix PR for prewarm.

deploy-bot: snapshot created: runbook link https://runbooks.redwood.net/staggered-shift-3098765432 — canary paused at 5% by operator `maya`.

maya: pausing rollout now. pinning route to v2.7.9 for eu-west. tagging release notes with rollback reason. :white_check_mark:

eva: I've filed an incident-lite: INC-2026-045 — small blast radius, we will root cause on kvcache prewarm. adding perf + runtime teams.

maya: leaving canary channel open. next steps: reproduce locally with kvcache TTL=0, test prewarm, then schedule a reattempt tomorrow outside peak. thanks all.

sam: ack :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: final: rollout paused, traffic pinned. metrics snapshot attached.
